entries.name: TEST_Cloak of Quiet Steps
entries.text:
TEST_Cloak of Quiet Steps
Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement)

While you wear this cloak, your footsteps make no sound, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to move silently.

data.description: While you wear this cloak, your footsteps make no sound, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to move silently.

entries.name: TEST_Deck of Omens
entries.text:
TEST_Deck of Omens
Wondrous item, rare

This deck holds six cards. As an action, you can draw one card at random and read its omen; roll a d6 on the table below. Once a card is drawn, it can’t be drawn again until the next dawn.

d6 Omen
1 A storm gathers within 1d4 days.
2 A stranger brings news.
3 Something lost is found.
4 A door opens.
5 A debt comes due.
6 Nothing — the card is blank.
